findings.topic: Exact unconditional device theorem and quantifiers
findings.statement: For each fixed 0<beta<=2^-11, choose k=floor(beta^(-8/17)/8). One strictly positive charge-preserving k-call input rho_beta and one initializer-independent deterministic unassisted encoder/decoder sequence give Q(V_s,tau)>=S(rho_beta)/k>=3/2+(ln(2)/4096)*beta^(64/17), with vanishing full-diamond error for every fixed normal tau. Convergence is pointwise in tau. For actual tau_pi only, the product-block coherent-information limit equals S(rho_beta)/k. Beta, k and rho_beta are fixed before the transmission horizon tends to infinity.
findings.limits: This is a reliable lower-bound exponent, not a sharp small-angle capacity law, a general capacity/feedback converse, or uniform initializer convergence. Beta=1/512 is outside its stated range; the source makes no improved numerical claim there.

findings.topic: Actual receiving chain from the new constructive result
findings.statement: The exact closest-point dual identifies A_k=(ln(2)/8)*v_k, where v_k=min_zeta Tr(sigma*H_zeta^2) over ALL prefix densities. A minimizing H satisfies T_k(sigma H)>=v_k*I, including boundary/rank-deficient minimizers. The analytic minimizer zeta is not a physical bath initializer. Endpoint-pattern orthogonality gives v_zeta<=k(k-1), ||H_zeta||<=k(k-1), ||G1||<=k^2. The all-prefix guard/meander theorem gives v_zeta>=(1/4)*sum_(r=0)^(k-3)(k-r-2)*2^(-r)*binom(r,floor(r/2)), hence v_k>=k^(3/2)/32 for k>=4 and A_k/k>=(ln(2)/256)*sqrt(k).
findings.receiving_use: The main source uses this full-operator optimizer and all-length lower in its uniform nonlinear construction, verifies the inherited exact-drift hypothesis, and invokes actual same-bath coding. Receiving use is present in the current assembled proof; it is not merely proposed by the constructive contribution.

findings.topic: Uniform nonlinear window and actual state
findings.statement: With b=beta^2, ell=ln(2), H minimizing v=v_k, X=-(ell/2)*sigma*H, m=3*ell*v/16, Y=(4*m/k)*sigma*(Q-k/2), rho=sigma+b*X+b^2*Y. For k>=4 and b*k^(17/4)<=2^-12, rho is strictly positive and charge preserving, exact bulk drift is <=-(ell*v*b^2/16)*I, and S(rho)-3*k/2>=ell*v*b^2/32. The physical bulk remainder satisfies ||R_b||<=4*k^5*b^2 uniformly over all prefix vectors. Exact zero bulk drift of sigma at every b lets the remainder contract only against rho-sigma; omitting that cancellation loses the bound. The chosen floor gives k>=4, k>=beta^(-8/17)/16 and b*k^(17/4)<=2^(-51/4)<2^-12, yielding the 64/17 exponent.
findings.limit: No O_k remainder or favorable local coefficient is silently extrapolated to growing k. The exact state and drift, not only the susceptibility, feed coding.

findings.statement: A preceding colored guard, oriented endpoint bits 01 and nonnegative EVERY middle partial sum select raw word differences P*(I-SWAP) tensor I_bath. These raw word identities hold through vacuum on the entire bath. Their identification with charge-raising/lowering pieces and physical G1 is BULK ONLY, obtained using a sufficiently deep algebraic core and the exact k-prefix representation valid on initial depth>=k. Root terms remain in the inherited Lyapunov remainder. Distinct endpoint pairs occupy orthogonal input-pattern matrix blocks, so retained squared contributions cannot cancel under any coherent/entangled prefix state.
findings.failures: Positive final height does not replace the meander condition (guard-present word 100111, endpoints 1,5); an unguarded word 011 also leaks a bath color. A vacuum C1 witness excludes a global raising/lowering extension. These counterexamples invalidate shortcuts, not every excluded pattern.

findings.statement: For fixed k,beta,rho and exact bulk inward operator drift, homogeneous Kraus grades yield positive A_Delta with sum I and the positive-form exponential identity. The finite root remainder gives overflow bounds. Maximum-probability exact spectral types have w_m>=(m+1)^(-rank rho), and domination transfers average overflow. Joint compression keeps the r^2 positive-block loss, auxiliary CPTP normalization, actual isometric encoder rather than the normalizer, and polar repair. The initial-tail comparison occurs outside type domination. Error is min{2,4*e_m+2*sqrt(1-Tr(P_(<=A_m)*tau))}; full and half conventions are explicit.
findings.limit: This unchanged older mechanism was checked for the new receiving hypotheses and byte binding; the old capacity/compression audit was not repeated. Rank rho=3^k and small drift allow enormous existence constants. No efficient minimizer, encoder/decoder compiler or useful finite horizon follows.

For each fixed k0, its all-horizon/all-normal upper is 3/2+8*k0^5*ln(2)*beta^4 below its exponential-in-k0 threshold, and optimized actual-tau_pi information excess is Theta_(k0)(beta^4) for k0>=2. The controlled logarithmic window stays restricted. New k(beta) grows beyond that window and eventually beats each fixed-k0 quartic coefficient; it does not refute that upper.
findings.actual_old_rates: Old pair: S(omega)/2>3/2+beta^4/1024 for every fixed 0<beta<1, with pointwise all-normal reliable coding. Old nonscalar rho4 deletes one reducing coherence and gives S(rho4)/4>S(omega)/2, with exact negative nonscalar operator drift. These remain available at beta=1/512. Original iid comparator: actual tau_pi, 0<=beta<=1/8, optimized common marginal may vary with horizon but is identical within it; Ic/n<=3/2+(4/n)^(2/3), with limit exactly 3/2 over all qutrit densities. Nonidentical one-site products and arbitrary correlations lie outside that iid theorem.

findings.topic: Exact finite diagnostic versus unproved stronger route
findings.statement: The source includes a finite exact k=4 closest-point certificate: v4=17/16 and A4=17*ln(2)/128, whereas the uniform-prefix value is 561/512 and is nonstationary over all densities. This finite certificate, k2..6 diagnostics and bounded guard replay do not prove quadratic all-length growth. The all-length k^(3/2) proof is analytic. UNIFORM_GROWTH_TRANSFER.md remains explicitly conditional on v_k>=k^2/32; its beta^(7/2) consequence is not an unconditional device theorem.
findings.limit: No current replay was run and no finite certificate was treated as an all-length or practical performance result.

findings.statement: Resolve the sharp asymptotic growth of v_k between k^(3/2) and k^2 under COMPLETE prefix minimization. Starting from exact token/input-only subblocks, either find extra non-meander patterns surviving every coherent prefix or construct a full prefix dual density giving O(k^(3/2)). Finite symmetric-prefix certificates are candidate evidence, not an all-k optimizer theorem. Any stronger lower must then pass the existing uniform transfer; its conservative k^5 remainder may become the next barrier. Sharp capacity order and nonzero-angle feedback equality remain broader open questions.
